title: Finance Schedule: Unused-Cycle Credit When a Monthly Delivery Pass Moves to the Annual Pass (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The unused-cycle credit of a switch into Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual under Delivery & Pickup Services depends on the plan's age in whole months from its enrollment date to the switch date. The credit is taken off the switch charge.

## Schedule

| Plan's age on the switch date | Unused-cycle credit |
|---|---|
| 18 whole months or more | the current subscription fee multiplied by the unused days of the current cycle and divided by the days in that cycle, rounded to the cent |
| at least 6 but fewer than 18 whole months | only whole unused weeks: the current subscription fee multiplied by 7 times the whole weeks, divided by the days in the cycle, rounded to the cent |
| fewer than 6 whole months | no credit; the rest of the current cycle is forgone |

## Terms

- **Current subscription fee.** The subscription fee of the pass held on the switch date, before the switch.
- **Unused days.** The days from the switch date to the current cycle's end date, the switch date not counted and the end date counted.
- **Days in the cycle.** The days of the current cycle, its start date and its end date both counted.
- **Whole weeks.** The number of complete 7-day weeks in the unused days.
- **Age.** Whole months from the enrollment date shown on the plan to the switch date: a plan enrolled on 20 November 2023 is 17 whole months old on 19 May 2025 and 18 on 20 May 2025.

## Worked figures (hypothetical)

Kestrel Delivery Pass Monthly at $5.99; current cycle 1 May to 31 May (31 days); switch on 12 May, leaving 19 unused days (13 May to 31 May).

| Plan's age | Working | Credit |
|---|---|---|
| 24 months | 5.99 multiplied by 19, divided by 31, is 3.6712… | $3.67 |
| 10 months | 19 days hold 2 whole weeks; 5.99 multiplied by 7 times 2, divided by 31, is 2.7051… | $2.71 |
| 4 months | no credit | $0.00 |

Kestrel Senior Delivery Pass at $3.99, current cycle 1 June to 30 June (30 days), switch on 20 June (10 unused days): at 18 months or more, 3.99 multiplied by 10 and divided by 30 is $1.33; at 6 to 17 months, 1 whole week gives 3.99 multiplied by 7 and divided by 30, 0.931, so $0.93.
